name: Redmine
description: Your Redmine tasks in Orca's sidebar, linked to workspaces and agents.

cover.alt: The Redmine logo on a white tile beside the title “Redmine for Orca” and the tagline “Your Redmine tasks, tied to workspaces and agents.”

statusBarItems.tooltip: Redmine: open tasks assigned to you

settings.title: Redmine URL
settings.description: Base address, without a trailing slash. The API key is entered in the panel and stored encrypted.

settings.title: Instructions for a new-workspace agent
settings.description: What the agent launched in a new workspace is asked to do. The task context (description and comments) is appended after it. Placeholders: {id} {subject} {url} {project} {tracker} {status} {priority} {assignee}. Leave empty for a default in Orca's language. It can still be edited in the panel before launching.

settings.title: Prompt for “Send to agent”
settings.description: Typed into a terminal of the current workspace, without pressing Enter. Newlines become spaces. The task description and comments go in a file; {contextFile} places its path, otherwise a sentence pointing to it is appended. Placeholders: {id} {subject} {url} {project} {tracker} {status} {priority} {assignee} {contextFile}. Leave empty for a default in Orca's language.

settings.title: Comments in the agent context
settings.description: Which task comments go into the context of an agent launched in a new workspace. Can be changed per launch in the panel.

settings.title: Maximum context size (characters)
settings.description: Cap for the task context block. When the full history does not fit, the oldest comments are left out first. Orca uses 12000 for its own integrations.

settings.title: Branch name for task workspaces
settings.description: When a new workspace's name or branch names a Redmine task (4077-…, #4077, rm-4077), its branch is set to this template. Placeholders: {id} {slug} (task title) {tracker} {project}. Example: {tracker}/{id}-{slug}. Empty: Orca's branch is kept.

settings.title: When a workspace is created for a task
settings.description: What the plugin writes to Redmine when a new workspace gets linked to a task, whoever created it.
enumLabels: Add a comment and move a new task to the next open status

settings.title: Name the task in launch prompts
settings.description: When an agent starts in a workspace linked to a Redmine task, add one line naming the task (number, subject and URL) to the launch prompt Orca submits, unless the prompt already names it. Off by default.

settings.title: Desktop notification when an agent on a task finishes
settings.description: Off by default. The follow-up always appears in the Redmine panel; this only adds a desktop notification, with the task number and subject and nothing from the description or comments.
enumLabels: When an agent finishes or needs input

settings.title: Show my open tasks in the status bar
settings.description: A number beside a flag in Orca's status bar, amber when a task is overdue and red when one has an urgent or immediate priority. Press it to open the Redmine panel. Hiding it also stops the refresh.

settings.title: Refresh the status bar count every (minutes)
settings.description: How often the worker asks Redmine for the count while Orca is open. The count also refreshes right after the panel changes a task.

settings.title: Name for a renamed workspace
settings.description: What “Rename workspace”, in a task linked to the focused workspace, names the workspace. Placeholders: {id} {subject} {tracker} {project}. Whitespace is collapsed, control characters are removed, the name is cut to 200 characters, and it always starts with the task number. Empty: {id} {subject}.
